replay_fit_semantics: one fit_text_space/fit_transform per official Regression Train prefix, text/row/cycle inputs only
fit_semantics: one residual-memory construction for each origin x observed/shuffled arm; no estimator refit
donors: present-stream rows, cycles 56 through origin, finite exact float64 impact_load

retrieval.text: replay the original A02 TF-IDF recipe from official Regression Train text prefixes only; persist/load standalone vectorizers, never load A02 predictor models
retrieval.tokenization_and_missing_text: exact original A02 _documents/_text_values implementation; missing/blank rows become empty strings and remain in the fit population
retrieval.prefix_population: ascending source rows with cycle_code 47 through origin; includes missing/blank stream rows as empty documents exactly as A02
retrieval.matching: exact equality of parsed float64 impact_load; no binning, rounding, or quantile edges
retrieval.geometry: search all same-impact donors for positive cosine top32, stable descending cosine then source row

residual: threat_rank minus final-mapped R06 OOF prediction using the frozen strictly-earlier source cutoff

shuffle.strata: exact donor cycle x exact impact_load x fixed R06 OOF prediction decile
shuffle.traversal: ascending cycle, impact_load, decile, and source row

fallback: exact R06 for missing stream, missing impact, or fewer than five positive-cosine same-impact neighbors

preflight.coverage_denominator: present-stream queries in each declared W4, W6, and E67 H12 view

source_boundaries.classification_labels_or_probabilities_o: never read or deserialized in this versioned run
source_boundaries.query targets: read only after all four durable bundles and independent integrity checks
source_boundaries.Regression threat_rank during text repla: not parsed or read; target values used only for post-start donor residuals and post-integrity query evaluation

amendment_context.research_question: Does density weighting retain predictive benefit when domain AUC is slightly below 0.55 but ESS and clipping pass?
amendment_context.origins: two fixed origins only; descriptive contrast, not evidence of a general AUC-to-task-gain relationship

no_rescue: preflight failure skips all task fits; no threshold, bin, seed, or recipe search
